```sql
WITH oldest_user AS (
    SELECT device_id, MAX(age) as max_age
    FROM gender_age
    GROUP BY device_id
),
oldest_devices AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT device_id
    FROM oldest_user
),
events_for_device AS (
    SELECT event_id
    FROM events_relevant
    WHERE device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM oldest_devices)
)
SELECT event_id
FROM events_for_device;
```

```sql
WITH highest_payments AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customerNumber,
        MAX(p.amount) AS max_amount
    FROM customers c
    JOIN payments p ON c.customerNumber = p.customerNumber
    GROUP BY c.customerNumber
),
top_customers AS (
    SELECT customerNumber
    FROM highest_payments
    ORDER BY max_amount DESC
    LIMIT 5
)
SELECT 
    o.addressLine1 || ' ' || o.addressLine2 AS entire_address,
    o.city,
    o.state,
    o.postalCode,
    o.country
FROM orders o
JOIN top_customers tc ON o.customerNumber = tc.customerNumber
ORDER BY tc.max_amount DESC;
```

```sql
WITH highest_paying_customers AS (
    SELECT customerNumber, MAX(amount) as max_amount
    FROM payments
    GROUP BY customerNumber
),
top_5_customers AS (
    SELECT hpc.customerNumber
    FROM highest_paying_customers hpc
    ORDER BY hpc.max_amount DESC
    LIMIT 5
)
SELECT 
    c.addressLine1 || c.addressLine2 as entire_address,
    c.country
FROM customers c
JOIN top_5_customers t ON c.customerNumber = t.customerNumber;
```

```sql
      SELECT AVG(avg_revenue)
      FROM directors
      JOIN movies2directors m2d ON dq.directorid = m2d.directorid
      GROUP BY directorid
    )
  );
```
